_description: Model parameters — values that define the Holistic Universe Model theory. Changing any value = different model. Source of truth for both tools/lib/constants.js and src/script.js.

foundational._retiredInputsNote: Plan 09 step 7c: the frozen era device's inputs left this block — holisticyearLength (the fitted unit, 335,317 yr), stepYears (its lattice grid) and inputmeanlengthsolaryearindays (the device's rounded mean tropical year, 365.2422 d; the J2000 tropical year is DERIVED from the IAU sidereal year and p_A in one home, @essrt/physics computeMeanTropicalYearJ2000Days). Plan 07 R10 had already removed the phase origin's inputs (temperatureGraphMostLikely, systemResetN). The literals gate fails if any of them returns. The K-device wheels' rates are the recorded pose block earth.kDeviceWheelPeriodYears.

earth._kDeviceInclinationPhaseNote: Plan 09 step 6: the scene scaffolding's K-device inclination-wheel phase at J2000, degrees — the J2000 perihelion longitude (102.94719°) minus the retired eccentricity law's anchor (21.77°), written as the exact double so the pose is bit-identical. It poses earthInvPlaneInclinationMean, the inclination path's zodiac offset and the perihelion wheel's offset base′ (eccentricityBaseDerived); no published quantity rides it (the engine places the Earth frame, the Sun and the Moon stack over the scaffold). The H/3 eccentricity law it once phased is deleted — Earth's e of date is the N-body series on every path.
earth._kDeviceWheelPeriodNote: Plan 09 step 7c: the scene scaffolding's K-device wheel periods in the scene's mean solar years, keyed by the wheel's index N (its identifier in the scaffold: the inclination wheel 3, the ecliptic wheel 5, the obliquity wheel 8, the axial/wobble wheel 13, the perihelion pair 16). Each wheel turns UNIFORMLY at its recorded J2000 rate (plan 09 step 5c) from the recorded phase kDeviceWheelPhaseAtJ2000Cycles × N; the engine places the Earth frame, the Sun and the Moon stack over the scaffold, so no observable rides them. Numerically the retired unit's 335,317/N, written as the exact doubles so the pose is bit-identical; they are NOT the model's precession periods (those are the dynamical values: T_p 25,771.6, the obliquity beat, the apsidal and nodal modes — the wheels read them 0.09…2 % off).
earth._kDeviceWheelPhaseNote: Plan 07 R10: the scene scaffolding's K-device wheel phase at J2000 — each wheel of index N (see kDeviceWheelPeriodYears) stands N × this turns on at J2000. Numerically the retired phase origin's (2000 − t₀)/H; kept as the device's RECORDED J2000 pose like earthtiltMean (the wheel geometry _kcFrameR bridges once), not a law. No observable rides it — the engine places the Earth frame, the Sun and the Moon stack over it — but the scene's world frame and every world-axis reader (the NASA-convention umbra diagnostic's aberration about world Y) do; measured: dropping it tilted the K pose 1.25° and moved that diagnostic 0.45″.

moon._moonMeeusLpCorrectionNote: RETIRED at plan 06 R3 item 1 (was 0.009097354859355077 deg = +32.75 arcsec, Step 5c moon-eclipse-optimizer). Measured against JPL Horizons' apparent Moon over 1970-2049 the series needs no anchor (-1.0 +/- 1.5 arcsec, flat in elongation); the value was the eclipse location tier's mean Sun compensated (its aberration kappa + the I2 long inequality + the trend-deltaT offset). Kept at 0 until the plumbing leaves (R4).

additionalBodies._description: angleCorrection and startpos were literals in src/script.js with no source of truth until now. (Plan 07 R8: the perihelionEclipticFraction pairs — [1,1] for all four, one full H standing in for four unrelated orbits — and the inclinationCycleAnchor phases left with the retired device; a body's perihelion period is the N-body chain's, and these four bodies have no chain.)
additionalBodies._typeNote: The minor-body `type` assignments are GEOMETRIC PLACEHOLDERS (borrowed from the planet I/II/III taxonomy so the shared geometry law can derive them). These bodies are more susceptible to planetary gravity disturbances and are expected to receive their own perturbation-aware type(s) in the precision-programme refit (Phase 20 post-renumber; pre-renumber 18). Note pluto/halleys currently derive via body-unique branches keyed on the body name in @essrt/physics/planets/geometry — their `type` field is not consumed by the derivation, so redefining it later changes nothing until the new branch is wired deliberately.

perihelionPassageRef._description: Planet perihelion passage reference JDs — phase-optimized for EoC alignment

_deepTimeNote: Plan 11 step 1: the deepTime block left this file. Its fitted values (α₃, α₄, τ_GIA, the recession regime) are the banked record data/deep-time-fitted.json; α₁ is the LLR-anchored input astro-reference moonReference.moonRecessionAlpha1PerMa; the two GIA rates are DERIVED from astro-reference giaCoxChaoPeltier; the ΔT stack's taper rides its own fit artifact (data/deltaT-4flag-fit.json shipped_taper). tools/constants/generate.mjs assembles DEFAULT_CONSTANTS.deepTime from those homes; the literals gate fails if the block returns here.
